name: flux-lights
description: Work with the Flux Lights stage lighting console running on your computer: read the show, find out why a fixture is dark, and propose patch edits that the operator applies in the console.

token.title: Flux Lights access token
token.description: In Flux Lights: Settings → AI assistant (MCP) → turn it on → Copy token.

url.title: Flux Lights address
url.description: Settings → AI assistant (MCP) in Flux Lights shows it after "Listening at". Keep the default unless you changed the port there.
